subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw make current-session deferred reset a permanent `after_compaction` hook capability, and should this same PR also introduce automatic tool-loop abort and terminal-overflow session reset policy?
rationale: The code can implement either direction safely, but repository policy treats plugin API contracts, fallback/reset behavior, and new implicit session lifecycle policy as maintainer-owned product decisions rather than mechanical bug fixes.

options.title: Approve narrow hook API
options.body: Keep the current-session deferred reset capability, split automatic tool-loop abort/reset and unrelated CI changes, then require exact-head live proof before merge.

options.title: Approve combined policy
options.body: Land the hook API and automatic overflow recovery together after owners explicitly accept the larger session-state behavior and exact-head rollout risk.

options.title: Pause the API
options.body: Hold or close this branch until a generic plugin lifecycle capability design supersedes the closed broad reset proposal.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Keep the current-session deferred reset capability, split automatic tool-loop abort/reset and unrelated CI changes, then require exact-head live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Codex compaction and harness-selection history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the cross-runtime product choice.
